To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Multi-instance learning models can be successfully adapted to identify paraphrase relations in Twitter; (2) Our model can capture lexically divergent pairs that differ from yet supplement existing work; (3) We present a novel methodology for crowd-sourcing paraphrase relations from Twitter; (4) Our model combined with previous work significantly improves state-of-the-art performance.

(1) our model achieves the performance competitive with the state-of-the- art method, which combines a latent variable model with a supervised classifier, and (2) we show the importance of capturing divergent paraphrases, which complement previous approaches.
